name: showLabel
label: Show filter group label
description: Toggle on to specify a name for this filter group.

name: label
label: Filter group label
description: A meaningful name for the filter group, which is visible to the user.

name: layout
label: Filter group layout
description: Select Horizontal to show the filters side by side. Select Vertical to show the filters in a column.

name: spacing
label: Filter spacing
description: Choose how far apart you want to space the filters.

name: showSelectedValuesInPill
label: Show values in pill
description: Show the selected filter elements inside the pill for all filters in the group

name: showBorder
label: Show border
description: Toggle on to display a line around the filter group.

name: showRoundCorners
label: Show round corners
description: Turn on to have the group border and radius match the pill border and radius.

name: bare
label: Bare
description: Toggle on to remove padding around the filter group to provide more compact positioning.

name: showApply
label: Show group apply
description: Toggle on to enable application of all filters in the group at once.

name: showClear
label: Show group clear
description: Toggle on to enable clearing all filters in the group at once.

name: showReset
label: Show group reset
description: Toggle on to enable resetting all filters in the group to their default values at once.

name: combineActions
label: Combine clear and reset
description: Toggle on to combine Clear and Reset into a single menu.

name: showSeparator
label: Show separator
description: Toggle on to show a line between the filters and other content on the dashboard.

name: filterMaxWidth
label: Max filter item width, px
description: Defines number of pixels allowed for the filters in the group.

name: cascadeScope
label: Filters scope used to determine whether a filter can be cascaded by other filters

name: isDashboard
description: Indicates whether the filter group is rendered in a dashboard
